objective: C-1 clean-only format and Galileo E1 receiver feasibility; no Q-SET training, threshold, attack scoring, or detection claim
receiver_configuration_order: single frozen primary configuration; no fallback or post-result tuning

success_gate.availability_mask: union of actually observed Galileo E1 PRNs; no fixed ten-slot panel
success_gate.receiver_raw_time_mapping: output counter maps through exact 25/2 ratio and fixed 205.25-input-sample FIR group delay
success_gate.telemetry_sync: auxiliary only; not a success gate
success_gate.two_window_physical_consistency: each panel >=4, common panel >=4, median Doppler delta <=500 Hz, median C/N0 delta <=15 dB, Doppler within +/-15 kHz, C/N0 15..65 dB-Hz
